title: src/test/shell/bazel:srcs_test fail with bazel @ HEAD due to new abseil directory

labels.name: P1
labels.description: I'll work on this now. (Assignee required)

body:
I built bazel @ a1c3231f3b48f22638529960257c59c71c38b668 and `src/test/shell/bazel:srcs_test` fails with the following output:

```
exec ${PAGER:-/usr/bin/less} "$0" || exit 1
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
//:srcs filegroup do not contains all the sources, missing:
third_party/py/abseil/BUILD
third_party/py/abseil/PKG-INFO
third_party/py/abseil/README.md
third_party/py/abseil/absl/__init__.py
third_party/py/abseil/absl/app.py
third_party/py/abseil/absl/command_name.py
third_party/py/abseil/absl/flags/__init__.py
third_party/py/abseil/absl/flags/_argument_parser.py
third_party/py/abseil/absl/flags/_defines.py
third_party/py/abseil/absl/flags/_exceptions.py
third_party/py/abseil/absl/flags/_flag.py
third_party/py/abseil/absl/flags/_flagvalues.py
third_party/py/abseil/absl/flags/_helpers.py
third_party/py/abseil/absl/flags/_validators.py
third_party/py/abseil/absl/logging/__init__.py
third_party/py/abseil/absl/logging/converter.py
third_party/py/abseil/absl/testing/__init__.py
third_party/py/abseil/absl/testing/_bazelize_command.py
third_party/py/abseil/absl/testing/absltest.py
third_party/py/abseil/absl/testing/flagsaver.py
third_party/py/abseil/absl/testing/parameterized.py
third_party/py/abseil/absl/testing/xml_reporter.py
third_party/py/abseil/absl_py.egg-info/PKG-INFO
third_party/py/abseil/absl_py.egg-info/SOURCES.txt
third_party/py/abseil/absl_py.egg-info/dependency_links.txt
third_party/py/abseil/absl_py.egg-info/requires.txt
third_party/py/abseil/absl_py.egg-info/top_level.txt
third_party/py/abseil/setup.cfg
third_party/py/abseil/setup.py
```

It seems that `abseil` is being picked up by [a genquery](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/blob/5ce914f32f5b6a3459df29060b45e5ec8b0e9ecc/src/test/shell/bazel/BUILD#L496). I can't figure out the fix.

CC: @akira-baruah @damienmg
